title: Speculative Decoding in Gemini 3 Flash
caption:
Gemini 3 Flash isn't predicting tokens one by one in production.

Here's what actually happens when modern LLMs stream text fast:

1. Standard Decoding — traditional autoregressive inference runs the full multi-billion parameter model for every single token, causing severe memory-bandwidth bottlenecks.
2. Draft Model Proposal — speculative decoding uses a tiny, fast draft model to quickly generate multiple candidate tokens ahead of time.
3. Target Verification — the primary model (like Gemini 3 Flash) evaluates all proposed draft tokens simultaneously in a single forward pass.
4. Token Acceptance — correct draft tokens are accepted instantly, while incorrect ones are rejected and corrected without wasted computation.

When choosing inference infrastructure, per-token latency and memory bandwidth matter far more than theoretical parameter counts.

No magic — just parallel matrix multiplication at scale.
